text:
Tara (People Ops): Heads-up Sydney hub folks: the Harbour Bridge will be closed for maintenance the morning of Mon Jul 6 (public holiday traffic restrictions). The building will be open, but expect significant transit delays and closed vehicle access to the usual drop-off. We're arranging alternate pickup points + a small travel stipend for impacted commuters. :australia:

Ben (Logistics): TL;DR: bridge closure on 2026-07-06 AM. Alternate drop-off points at Circular Quay East and Wynyard. Free shuttle runs 07:00-10:00. One-off commute stipend AUD 25 for those who incur taxi/ride-share due to closure. RSVP form link (internal) in the event page.

Alyssa (Security): Note: vehicle access via Kent St will be restricted 06:00-11:00 on Jul 6. All visitors must pre-register. No unscheduled deliveries between 05:30-11:30. If you have sensitive equipment arriving, contact security for an escorted drop-off window.

Devon (Eng): I have a rack coming in that day for a demo; how strict are the delivery windows?

Ben (Logistics): We can reserve a 30-minute escorted drop-off at Wynyard between 11:30-12:30 if you can't shift the delivery. Email ops-logistics@redwood.ai with truck ETA and dimensions by EOD Thursday.

Tara (People Ops): Commuter stipend details:
- One-off AUD 25 for ride-share/taxi on Jul 6 if you normally take public transport and have >30min added travel time.
- To claim, take a photo of the receipt and submit via the expense form within 10 days.

TravelBot: Stipend rule created: SYD-BRIDGE-2026-03. Submit receipts before 2026-07-16.

Devon (Eng): If I decide to work remotely that day, is that okay? I have a newborn at home, so avoiding transit would be ideal.

Tara (People Ops): Yes — hybrid policy applies. If you need additional childcare support because commuting is disrupted, we have a one-time childcare voucher of AUD 80 for that day. Reply to this thread or DM People Ops to request the voucher.

Alyssa (Security): For those driving to the alternate drop-off, leave your badge visible and bring photo ID. We'll have security at Circular Quay East from 06:45. No unauthorized tailgating or access to loading docks.

Ben (Logistics): Shuttle schedule: Circular Quay East -> Hub at 07:00, 07:30, 08:00, 08:30, 09:00. Return shuttles 16:30, 17:00, 17:30. Priority seating for caregivers and folks with mobility needs.

Tara (People Ops): Expense template to paste into the claim form:
```
Expense: Taxi - Bridge closure
Amount: AUD 28.50
Date: 2026-07-06
Category: Travel - One-off commute stipend
Notes: Harbour Bridge closure - Circular Quay to Hub
```

Devon (Eng): Will the onsite cafe be open earlier due to shuttle start time? I might not get coffee otherwise. :coffee:

Ben (Logistics): Cafe will open at 07:30 for that day. We'll provide a small complimentary coffee stand at the welcome area from 07:00-09:00 while shuttles are running.

TransitBot: Public transport alert: Ferry schedules may be busier than usual; allow extra 20-35 minutes and expect queueing at Circular Quay.

Alyssa (Security): Accessibility note: if you need an accessible shuttle or help with mobility, mark \"assistance\" on the RSVP. We'll reserve a spot and have an escort.

Tara (People Ops): RSVP deadline for shuttle/assistance: Jul 1. If you miss it, still come to Circular Quay East and we'll help, but booking helps us prioritize.

TravelBot: Reminder scheduled: RSVP cutoff Jul 1. Reference: RSVP-SYD-2026-07.

Devon (Eng): Thanks — appreciate the clear plan. One last ask: can we get a badge exception if our badge access fails at Circular Quay gates?

Alyssa (Security): We'll have a temporary guest pass table for Redwood staff at Circular Quay East. Bring ID and your mobile device for check-in. If you have badge issues later, file a security ticket and we'll investigate.

Tara (People Ops): Thanks everyone. We'll drop a follow-up with a map of shuttle pickup points and a short FAQ tomorrow. Any urgent needs DM People Ops or reply here. Stay safe if you're traveling that morning. :map:
